what.text: This page follows refugees from Haiti living in Brazil, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 105410 Haitian refugees in Brazil, 58.3% of all refugees from Haiti.
Brazil is the largest host of Haitian refugees, followed by France, Canada and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Haiti in 2004, with FLRN and OP Lavalas, and again from 2024 to 2025 with Viv Ansanm.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2023 to 2025, fall in the same period as the most recent conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2009 at 5 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Brazil.
These are year-end totals for Brazil only, reported to UNHCR.
